verdict.rationale: CrewAI is a code-first Python framework with an official CLI to create, train, run, and manage crews and flows. It also has `crewai test` for scripted, iteration-based runs with metrics, and REST endpoints (POST /kickoff, GET /status, POST /resume) for triggering deployed crews programmatically, all of which support headless automation. missing for 10: explicit CI documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions examples, exit codes, non-interactive flags), independent hands-on reports of running in CI pipelines.
